items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I went to Mickey Baker, Sam Taylor, Ernie Hays, Lloyd Trotman, and I said to them, I said, 'Well, look, man, why can't we start a record company of our own?' ... Right, he was one of the base players, but he was the other one they used to do on the dates.

ctx.x: after that -- he came in later on. But I started out with Atlantic Records, and I tried to get -- after I saw what was happening, that Atlantic was making all this money with these hits that they had, songs on the charts and everything, which was another thing that was just being started -- by Variety and the different magazines, of putting songs on charts.
I went to the guy -- I went to Mickey Baker, Sam Taylor, Ernie Hays, Lloyd Trotman, and I said to them, I said, 'Well, look, man, why can't we start a record company of our own?'
Now wait a minute -- I want you to define these guys. Mickey Baker was the hot guitarist then, right?
